privacyModal.intro: At Alta Cima Aventura, we take the protection and confidentiality of our clients' and users' personal data very seriously.
privacyModal.section1Desc: Data gathered through our website or WhatsApp forms (name, phone number, and quote details) is strictly used for customer support, logistical coordination, and responding to service requests.
privacyModal.section2Desc: We guarantee that your personal information will not be sold, rented, or shared with third parties under any circumstances, except by explicit legal or judicial requirement. Your data is protected under secure storage protocols.
privacyModal.section3Desc: We may use your contact details to send technical reservation details, promotions, or information about upcoming adventure trips, with the option to opt-out at any time.
privacyModal.section4Desc: You may at any time request the update, correction, or complete deletion of your personal data from our databases by sending a direct message to our official support channels.

termsModal.intro: By booking or contracting any service from Alta Cima Aventura (Tourism, Construction, B2B Events, or Height Work), the user or client expressly accepts the following terms and conditions.
termsModal.section1Desc: All operations by Alta Cima abide by strict risk management protocols and international certifications. Participants and clients commit to following 100% of the instructions provided by technical staff and guides.
termsModal.section2Desc: For adventure tourism or corporate events, participants declare themselves to be in optimal physical and mental health condition, notifying any relevant medical condition in advance.
termsModal.section3Desc: Bookings for trips, day trips, or construction require the down payment specified during quoting. In case of extreme weather or force majeure cancelations, activities will be rescheduled with safety as top priority.
termsModal.section4Desc: Adventure engineering works (climbing walls, ziplines, parks) and industrial setups include installation warranties and certified equipment datasheets.
